technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Central Elektroniği, see TSB/TPI 2010355.
If the Central Electronic Kontrol Modülü has the Part Number 3C0-937-049-E and the Seat Heating Regulator has the Part Number is 1Z0-959-772-A while there are no Function Limitations, the Fault has to be ignored.
